project: Shadow of the Beast PC Port
approach: Original PS4 x86-64 game code running directly on Windows through replacement PS4 system libraries and a Vulkan renderer derived from shadPS4
notes: Bring-up foundation: TRG launcher, direct installation from the user's own compatible PS4 package, build fingerprint validation, native loader, PS4 system-library runtime, shadPS4-derived GNM/VideoOut core and actionable logs. Gameplay has not been tested yet. No game files are included.
